research_question: Do the derived balanced and contrarian components add independent candidate information to the five-component mean-z consensus, or do they algebraically duplicate recent30 and gap and overweight gap?
novelty_statement: E080/E081 compared rank aggregators and E082 measured ranker dependence; none tested the algebraic redundancy of the two derived components by a single preregistered candidate-only ablation with the same fixed three-line allocator. This is one challenger, no parameter search.

feature_definitions.recent30: Main-number counts over the preceding 30 draws, population z-scored over 45 numbers.
feature_definitions.gap: Completed draws since the last main-number appearance, population z-scored over 45 numbers.
feature_definitions.momentum: (frequency in last 10 draws / 10) - (frequency in preceding 20 draws / 20), population z-scored; exact ranking tie score 2*count(last10)-count(preceding20).
feature_definitions.challenger_base_three: (recent30_z + gap_z + momentum_z)/3. Remove both derived components without changing the three base signal formulas.

candidate_stage.primary_estimand: Paired difference in candidate_recall@30: challenger minus full_five_consensus.
candidate_stage.miss_trace: For each winning slot, record rank positions under both models and first K at which retained; do not store winning number values or candidate lists.

inference.bootstrap: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap; 4,000 replicates; 50-target contiguous blocks sampled with replacement; retain final one-target remainder in every replicate.

portfolio_stage.allocator: Fixed rank partition of each model's top 18: ranks 1-6, 7-12, and 13-18 become exactly three six-number lines.

historical_evaluation.cutoff_rule: For each target t, all features/ranks use only main-number draws 1..t-1; target outcome is read only after both rankings and portfolios are frozen.

guardrails: One fixed challenger only; no post-result variants, weight search, threshold search, or allocator search.
Candidate selection and portfolio allocation are reported separately.
No candidate numbers, TOP30, core/tail lists, or purchase lines in user-facing output.
Targets 1244-1251 are contaminated live-history diagnostics, not clean holdout or prospective confirmation.
No model or allocator promotion unless the unchanged strict gate and prospective policy requirements are met.
No random fallback and no DELIVERY_LOG event.
